A Complete Design Education in Two Years

Based on Pratt’s Manhattan Campus, the two-year Associate of Occupational Studies (AOS) degree programs deliver the same number and level of art and design courses as a BFA program in half the time by eliminating gen-ed courses. Ours are the only solely design-focused AOS programs in the United States. Students are immersed in the studio from day one, beginning with foundational art and design courses that set the basis for advanced courses in traditional illustration, digital illustration, painting/drawing, communications design, and more.

Career-Track Degree

Whether you are looking to illustrate children’s books, freelance for print or online publications, work at an agency, or apply your skills to other industries, the AOS Illustration curriculum is specially curated for those who want to gain the expert skills required to become a working illustrator. This program is ideal for those considering a move into illustration, offering advanced courses with a professional focus.

Where Our Alumni Work

  • Brolga – Freelance (Apple, BMW, Target, Jaguar, Nike, H&M, NYT)
  • Helen Escobar – Brooklyn Born Chocolate
  • Rinn Wight – Pratt Institute

Gain Industry Experience Through Internships

Pratt has deep roots in the New York City art and design worlds, and our second-year AOS students gain invaluable real-world experience and connections through internships. Students have held internships in a range of organizations, from The Painting Center to Marvel Studios.

You will have access to traditional art and design studios, labs with cutting-edge hardware and software, and print facilities with endless possibilities. Learning resources.

A Complete Design Education in Two Years

Based on Pratt’s Manhattan Campus, the two-year Associate of Occupational Studies (AOS) degree programs deliver the same number and level of art and design courses as a BFA program in half the time by eliminating gen-ed courses. Ours are the only solely design-focused AOS programs in the United States. Students are immersed in the studio from day one, beginning with foundational art and design courses that set the basis for advanced courses in graphic design, communications design, package design, interactive media, typography, and more.

“Take advantage of all the resources you have here. There’s so much you can do. As long as you have the ideas and you’re creative, you can do practically anything with that.” 

Kailea Zheng, AOS Graphic Design ’24
Read More

Career-Track Degree

Whether you are looking to work at an agency, in-house with a brand, freelance, or apply your skills to other industries, the AOS Graphic Design curriculum is specially curated for those who want to gain the expert skills required to become a working graphic designer. This program is ideal for those considering a move into graphic design, offering advanced courses with a professional focus.

Where Our Alumni Work

Alums address critical challenges and create innovative work that reimagines our world at a diverse selection of companies and institutions as well as their own studios and businesses.

  • Harrison Jude,  Adweek
  • Chantal Hernandez,  Hearst Magazines
  • Dana Baumgartner,  Mouth & iGourmet

Gain Industry Experience Through Internships

Pratt has deep roots in the New York City art and design worlds, and our second-year AOS students gain invaluable real-world experience and connections through internships. Students have held internships in a range of organizations, from The Painting Center to Marvel Studios.

Learn on State-of-the-Art Tools

You will havande access to traditional art and design studios, labs with cutting-edge hardware and software, and print facilities with endless possibilities. Learning resources.

“Learning about printing processes is one thing, but getting to see it in action right next to the machine is a whole different beast. My design process is now backed by some firsthand knowledge, and that’s awesome.”

Finn Evans, AOS Graphic Design ’24; AOS Illustration ’25
Read More

Sign Up For a Tour

Tour Pratt’s Associate Degree Department Manhattan headquarters to get a better feel for the close-knit, professional learning environment. Department Chair Susan Young personally leads every tour—contact her at aos@pratt.edu to arrange a time. 

Outstanding Faculty Prepare You for the Professional World

As some of New York’s leading art and design experts, our faculty have a deep passion for teaching the next generation of creative professionals. They will prepare you to enter your chosen field with the skills, knowledge, and confidence to succeed.

  1. John De Santis

An Industry-Focused Degree

Our program offers an industry-focused degree with an emphasis on professional preparation. As you pursue your degree, you will work with real-world clients under the mentorship of our faculty.

Student Work

  • Scott Stegman, AOS Graphic Design

  • Peter Gibson, AOS Graphic Design, ’25

  • Satchel McLaughlin, AOS Graphic Design

  • Nick Malandrino, AOS Graphic Design

  • Harrison Jude, AOS Graphic Design

  • Finn Evans, AOS Graphic Design, ’24

A Supportive Environment

A strong focus on community and collaboration sets Pratt’s Associate Degree Department apart. Here, you join a tight-knit, supportive environment with intentionally small classes and personal attention from our outstanding faculty and staff. You will have access to the full college experience and the option to live on Pratt’s beautiful, tree-lined Brooklyn campus. 

Career Resources for Life

Students and alumni can schedule one-on-one appointments in Pratt’s Center for Career and Professional Development. These sessions pair you with a career strategist who can help develop your job/internship search strategies and life and business plans, as well as review résumés, cover letters, websites, and other marketing materials.

The AOS program is a professional degree designed for high school graduates and adults with or without previous college experience. This is an intensive, two-year, all art-and-design-based curriculum, offering a strong foundation in design along with capstone courses, internship opportunities, and a professional portfolio upon graduation. The program attracts highly motivated students who, upon completing their studies, move quickly into the fields of graphic design, advertising, illustration, web design, game design, package design, and publishing, as well as an array of interactive media fields.
